title: Supper and Cross Connection Grid
purpose: Support the primary activity for The Cross in the Story.
body_markdown:
# Supper and Cross Connection Grid

Use Luke 22:14-23; 23:44-49 as your evidence.

1. Write or draw three direct observations.
2. Mark one interpretation or conclusion.
3. Name one careful response.
4. Put a question mark beside anything the passage does not settle by itself.
